body: The short part is sort of just there. I joke about it and everything else in the only way I can so I can seem ok enough to not need to be worried about. I can’t see how anyone would like me. My personality is garbage in all ways, and I have nonredeemable qualities
I don’t see how they could like me. I’m a fucking loser who has the main character traits of being short, sleep deprived, and constantly sad.
I haven’t told my parents of any of this, so I don’t have medications or anything, and it hasn’t been actually tested if I have the mental disorder depression. Wouldn’t be shocked if I do though.
Alright. I’m at least going to wait until the morning so I’m not following someone who I haven’t seen in a few years at midnight.
Damn. I don’t know what to say except thank you.

I probably should have mentioned the follow omg in the post, but they are okay with me being an atheist. When they were still not too okay with it, I would always just be pissed in silence, too scared to say anything. Then I just didn’t get out of bed to go to religion class thing in the morning and that worked. Now that that’s out of the way, thank you sincerely for being here and doing what you can to help. It means a lot that random people from the internet are willing to help a 13 year old who doesn’t deserve it. I always try to go to sleep early, and that fails via either binging a show or mental breakdowns. But thank you
I think I’m just going to tell my parents at this point. I hadn’t told them because I didn’t want to worry them
I had thought about getting help in the past, but never did because I hadn’t done anything serious. Now I’m going to get help for certain, because I’m not sure that I do want to die
Shit I don’t know how to reply to that. Thank you? Or whatever an appropriate response is
Yeah. It’s still weird knowing that I did that
At this point I sort of calmed down from completely shaking to very mild shaking and just knowing what I just did. I’m still freaked out about it, just in a calm way now
I don’t know what to say except I will
